info.title: EstatePro API
info.description: Multi-tenant real estate and property management API. Conventions: docs/decisions/ADR-003-api-conventions.md

name.description: Name in the best matching Accept-Language, else the default name

isCompanyDefined.description: false = platform default (read-only); true = this company’s own type

countryCode.description: Limit to one country; omit for all countries

unit.description: "plot" is kept as entered; it has no fixed size in square metres

tenureCode.description: Tenure code from the "tenure" picklist for the property’s country

jurisdictionCode.description: Defaults to the office jurisdiction when in the same country

timezone.description: IANA time zone; defaults to the office (same country) or the country default

createWholePropertyUnit.description: Also create the single "Whole property" unit (houses, plots)

sqm.description: Square metres; null for units with no fixed size (plot)

tenureCode.description: Tenure code from the "tenure" picklist for the property’s country

jurisdictionCode.description: Defaults to the office jurisdiction when in the same country

timezone.description: IANA time zone; defaults to the office (same country) or the country default

energyRating.description: Energy rating where the market uses one (e.g. EPC band)

featureCodes.description: Codes from the "feature" picklist; replaces the full set
